title: Near-optimal Turán densities of $r$-graphs on $r+1$ vertices
summary: Let $π(H)$ be the Turán density of an r-uniform hypergraph $H$ and let $H_k^r$ denote the $r$-uniform hypergraph on $r+1$ vertices with exactly $k$ edges, where $1\le k\le r+1$. Sidorenko~(JCT-B, 2024) proved that $π(H_3^r)\ge (1.7215-o(1))r^{-2}$ as $r\to\infty$ and $π(H_k^r)\ge (C_k+o(1))r^{-(1+1/(k-2))}$ for fixed $k$ as $r\to\infty$. Clemen~later improved the first bound to $π(H_3^r)\ge cr^{-2}\sqrt{\log r}$ for some constant $c>0$.
